budget.decision: Budget enlargement and fresh-source counts were authorized independently before reading first-study qualification results; retain and report both studies in full.
budget.primary_checkpoint_selection: Compare 8 and 64 updates only on original development CE; report every checkpoint on fresh qualification.

protocol.actor: ridge conditional moment on development only; selects one full bundle, not post-hoc modalities
protocol.sources: source-uniform then event-uniform sampling; source-balanced population CE
protocol.execution_platform: Linux CPU research runner (resource.rusage includes child codec CPU)
protocol.scope: bounded natural 0.5s infilling with label caption; no open-domain synthesis claim
protocol.proxy_warmstart: differentiable media/text losses; explicitly not an exact delivered-NDU gradient
protocol.actual_gradient: full joint-batch score-function with previous-batch baseline (retains shared runtime-cost cross terms), Gaussian image/video/audio and categorical text emission law; all actual returns from PNG/WAV/FFV1/UTF8 reopening
protocol.risk_arm_objective: same frozen population moment cost as final profile, no auxiliary loss during actual-gradient stage
protocol.uniform_arm_objective: equal-budget expected-return comparator (gamma=0); final evaluation uses the common gamma=2 profile
protocol.cost_note: All self+child CPU charges include serialization/readback and scoring; batch execution costs are measured at the executed batch size, and inference latency is reported separately.
protocol.failure_policy: record zero gross utility and all incurred cost; continue qualification without replacement

expanded_continuation.neural_emission_law: Unchanged Gaussian image/video/audio and categorical text; fixed_neural mean/argmax
expanded_continuation.actor: Development-fitted positive softplus moment; choose one whole bundle from seven candidates before emission
expanded_continuation.stop: One completed four-modality bundle or explicit failure; exactly two neural transitions where selected
expanded_continuation.cost: Same frozen actual CPU tariff; expanded actor charges its online feature extraction

profile_migration: 8-step checkpoints explicitly retain their original training profile and are re-evaluated under the expanded 7-candidate continuation; objective/scorer/cost/risk fields are unchanged
online_actor_feature_billing_correction: Online public-context features are now measured inside each executed actor/NN path; no generator or quality threshold changed.
primary_selection: highest original-development NDU CE among ndu_8 and ndu_64
